headline: IShowSpeed got his hands on Apple’s first foldable and the first song that came on was Ye
body: IShowSpeed got his hands on Apple’s first foldable and the first song that came on was Ye and Jay-Z’s “N***** In Paris.”😂🔥 Via: Speed found the phone with the song already there. He goes, “Why is that the song right now?” Then he said he wanted to test it. Holds the iPhone Duo open, Watch the Throne artwork filling the screen, then goes, “That’s special.” Then he tells them to cut it off. The phone just got announced. 5.4-inch cover, 7.6-inch inner display, starts at $1,999, pre-orders October 16. First foldable iPhone Apple’s ever made. And the record he tested it with is still one of the biggest from Watch the Throne. 2011. Jay and Ye. Stadium song on a brand new $2,000 foldable.
